_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Vachezi veSnake pabodo {width}×{height}.
Unotonga nyoka {player_id}. Zvinyatswa zviri zvema: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (kana w/s/a/d).
Chinangwa: tarisira kureva kwenguva refu zaidi kana uwe nyoka murefu zaidi uwe na alama ya juu (mipaka ya zamu {max_turns} zamu).

game_action.invalid_death: Nyoka {player_id} yakafa pamusana pekufamba kusina kukodzera.

outcome.all_dead_simul: Nyoka dzose dzakafa panguva imwe chete.
outcome.turn_limit: Kuchinja kwakaganhurirwa kwasvika - zvibodzwa zvakanakisisa zvinokunda tie-break.
